title: Smart Clock
summary: An STM32 clock with alarms, weather, and scrolling news.
description: A custom clock built around an STM32 microcontroller and a DFRobot LCD. It brings time, recurring alarms, room conditions, weather forecasts, and RSS headlines together on one display.
highlights: Uses IP-based geolocation to fetch time, time zone, daylight-saving data, and location at startup.
Supports recurring alarms with snooze, mute, and enable/disable controls.
Displays room temperature and humidity alongside weather forecasts refreshed every 15 minutes.
Accepts a city name or precise coordinates for weather forecasts.
Scrolls RSS headlines and removes feed HTML from the displayed text.

title: UiASub RTOS
summary: Embedded communication between an ROV and its topside controls.
description: A ZephyrOS application for the UiASub remotely operated vehicle. The microcontroller acts as a central communication point for sensors, joystick input, and diagnostics, with bitmask communication and an Ethernet connection to topside.
highlights: Collects sensor information for transmission to topside.
Connects joystick input and diagnostics with the ROV.
Designed for a microcontroller with limited resources.
Uses a precomputed CRC32 lookup table for communication checks.

title: AI Dashcam
summary: Traffic sign recognition using a custom fine-tuned YOLO model.
description: A traffic sign detection and recognition project using YOLOv11 with custom fine-tuned weights. A FastAPI backend connects the model to a web interface, with Label Studio used to refine the training annotations.
highlights: Detects traffic signs in video input.
Uses a labeled dataset to fine-tune the model.
Includes a web interface for the recognition workflow.
Refines inconsistent annotations through a structured Label Studio workflow.

title: Mario Game
summary: A C++ platformer with custom levels, sprites, and collision handling.
description: A two-dimensional platform game inspired by Mario, built in C++ with SDL2. The project combines custom levels and sprites with jumping, coin collection, enemies, and collision detection.
highlights: Implements jumping, collecting coins, and defeating enemies.
Uses custom sprites, tiles, and level layouts.
Uses a spatial grid for collision detection.

title: Studak
summary: A student activity app for finding and arranging things to do.
description: A React Native app for students to discover and organize activities based on budget, group size, and location. Firebase provides authentication and Firestore stores the activity data.
highlights: Filters activities by budget, group size, and location.
Includes a calendar for arranging activities with friends.
Uses Firebase authentication and Firestore queries.
Supports user profiles, friend lists, and invitations.
Uses optimized Firestore queries for activity filtering and results.

title: GodforsakenPlace
summary: An online Mafia game with lobbies, roles, and live updates.
description: An online adaptation of the Mafia social deduction game. Players join lobbies using game codes, take on different roles, and move through day and night phases. React provides the interface and a .NET backend uses SignalR for live communication.
highlights: Uses lobby codes to bring players into the same game.
Supports role-based actions during day and night phases.
Uses SignalR for chat and game state updates.
Includes Mafia, Detective, and Citizen roles, with guest play and registered accounts.
Stores game data and user profiles in an Azure-hosted database.
Uses DALL-E character illustrations with a consistent visual style.

title: Portfolio Website
summary: This portfolio: a small workshop world with projects to discover.
description: A Flask portfolio that brings projects, work experience, education, and contact into a stylized workshop. One project catalog and profile supply the interactive exhibits and accessible page content.
highlights: Shares one catalog between physical project exhibits, the index, and project details.
Brings work experience, education, skills, and contact into the workshop.
Keeps readable content available when the 3D scene cannot run.
Uses modular CSS and JavaScript, with a CI/CD deployment workflow.

title: UiA RAG System
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation developed for the University of Agder.
description: A RAG system developed for UiA, combining retrieval with indexing and chunking of structured data.
highlights: Organizes structured data for retrieval.
Uses indexing and chunking as part of the retrieval workflow.
